title: Figure 16: Schematic of power oscillator optics for a high-power laser
description: Schematic of a laser cavity showing end mirrors M1 and M2, an acoustic muffler "AM", an "E-Gun" and an output scraper "SP" along a dashed optical axis. A legend lists "End Mirrors: M1 Concave (R1 =97m), M2 Convex (R2=24m)", "Magnification: M=4", output scraper dimensions, "Cavity Length: 36.5m", "Gain Length: 3m" and "Aperture: 0.3x0.3 m". Caption: "Figure 16. Schematic of Power Oscillator Optics [29]."
